briefing: 今日导读：谷歌推出支持Claude的新办公Agent，进一步推动了AI在办公领域的多功能整合。与此同时，Edi Life OS为个人生活管理提供了自托管方案，提升了数据安全。AgentGarten提供了AI在实时环境中学习的新平台。AI领域在多个方向呈现新的突破和应用。
highlights: 今日看点：AI在办公场景和个人生活管理的拓展，再次强调了AI集成和多功能性的重要性。谷歌通过其办公Agent和Gemini应用展现了对多功能集成的重视，而Edi Life OS则提供了个人数据管理的新方案。此外，AgentGarten为智能体学习提供了创新平台。这些变化展示了AI在工作效率和个人管理上不可忽视的趋势。

events.title: AgentGarten：AI的实时试炼场
events.summary: AgentGarten是一个为人工智能提供实时试炼的环境，旨在让智能体在边玩边进化的过程中，通过反复试错进行学习。这个平台的出现将推动AI的发展和应用。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
AgentGarten 为 AI 智能体提供了一个实时互动和学习的平台。

### 为什么令人兴奋
该平台允许 AI 智能体在动态环境中进行试错学习，提升自适应和自由调整能力。

### 产品机会
这种实时学习环境可用于开发具有自我学习和调整能力的智能设备或应用，尤其适用于游戏和动态任务。

### 格局影响
这个技术增强了开源和实验性 AI 技术的吸引力，可能会对传统封闭环境中的学习模型构成挑战。

### 冷静判断
目前为实验阶段，距离实际生产环境应用还有距离，但其验证的技术方向值得关注。

### 趋势坐标
呼应近期对 AI 自主学习和动态适应能力的趋势需求，与最近讨论的沙箱技术限制问题有内在关联。

articles.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
articles.text: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner . It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's reports don't come with human review: The outputs of this opt-in vulnerability scanner will be fully model-generated, without human review or triage. articles.title: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
articles.text: Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the Gemini agent and assign it tasks from a single interface. In addition to having Gemini work directly inside Workspace apps like Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, and others, users can interact with the agent from their mobile device, desktop computer, the web, and third-party apps like Slack or Microsoft 365. Since it runs in the cloud, Gemini will maintain the same context across … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
articles.text: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch . The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight , is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model . Similar to AI note-taking apps like Granola and Wispr Flow, Foresight summarizes your meetings while providing a space where you can take your own notes. Google says you can jot down shorthand bullet points during your meeting, and the app will transform them into "polished notes" based on the information in the transcript. Along with transcribing your meetings, For … Read the full story at The Verge.
